title: Logos 24 opening: human affections of the Savior
english: Twenty-fourth discourse. On human sayings of the Savior — he wept, my soul is troubled, let this cup pass, and like texts.
Passible language is kept with the economy in flesh so bare Godhead is not made afraid.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Condensed lemma-led tip.
No Greystone wording. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
